roadmap.title: Establish the base and reach Trees
roadmap.description: Build the core terraformation machines, explore the nearby ore caves, open Golden Crates, and raise the world through the Trees stage.

roadmap.title: Automate the late terraformation climb
roadmap.description: Build trading, drone, portal, farm, and genetics infrastructure while advancing from Insects to Complete Terraformation.

roadmap.title: Finish Prime exploration and the Warden route
roadmap.description: Visit the remaining biomes, open Ancient Paradise and The Cenote, collect the Warden Key Detector, and prepare ten spare keys.

roadmap.title: Take all three exits and finish counters
roadmap.description: Use the automatic pre-ending save for Sentinel Corp, Wardens, and smugglers, then close the 100,000-token and 1,000-item totals.

achievements.summary: Raise the Terraformation Index to 175 kTi and reach the @mechanic{Blue Sky} stage.

guide.context: The Terraformation Index combines Oxygen, Heat, Pressure, and Biomass; Biomass itself combines Plants, Insects, and Animals.

steps.text: Keep the highest available Oxygen, Heat, Pressure, and Biomass machines powered, and launch multiplier rockets when their blueprints become available.
Monitor the Terraformation Screen until the total reaches 175 kTi and the stage display changes to @mechanic{Blue Sky}.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Living Compartment}.

guide.context: The Living Compartment blueprint is available from the beginning.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Living Compartment} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 2 Iron and 1 Titanium.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Living Compartment}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Launch Platform}.

guide.context: The blueprint becomes usable when you unlock it at 345 kTi.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Launch Platform} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 3 Iron, 3 Super Alloy, and 3 Titanium.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Launch Platform}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Biodome}.

guide.context: The blueprint becomes usable when you unlock it by reaching 100 nK of Heat.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Biodome} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 1 Aluminum, 2 Cobalt, 1 Seed Lirma, 3 Super Alloy, and 2 Titanium.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Biodome}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Flower Spreader}.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Flower Spreader} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 1 Fertilizer, 1 Magnesium, 1 Super Alloy, and 3 Water Bottles.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Flower Spreader}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Tree Spreader} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.

Open the Construction menu, select @item{Tree Spreader}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Food Grower} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.

Open the Construction menu, select @item{Food Grower}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Nuclear Reactor} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 1 Explosive Powder, 1 Super Alloy, 3 Uranium Rods, and 3 Water Bottles.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Nuclear Reactor}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{DNA Manipulator} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 1 Zeolite, 1 Super Alloy, 1 Osmium, 1 Explosive Powder, and 1 Bioplastic Nugget.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{DNA Manipulator}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Collect one piece of @item{Iridium} from the Iridium Mine.

guide.context: Iridium can also appear in containers, becoming increasingly common after the Blue Sky stage.

steps.text: Travel to the Iridium Mine and look for the red crystalline ore on the cave floor.
Pick up one loose @item{Iridium} to register the discovery.

achievements.summary: Collect one piece of @item{Osmium} from the Osmium Cave after its ice melts.

guide.context: The Osmium Cave opens after the Lakes stage or after Heat reaches 15 nK; Osmium can also appear in later-stage containers.

steps.text: Raise Heat to 15 nK or reach the Lakes stage so the ice blocking the Osmium Cave melts.
Enter the cave and pick up one blue @item{Osmium} crystal.

achievements.summary: Collect one piece of @item{Zeolite} from the Zeolite Cave after reaching Moss.

guide.context: Loose Zeolite becomes available at the Moss stage and is also rare container loot through the Amphibians stage.

steps.text: Raise the Terraformation Index to 200 MTi and enter the Moss stage.
Travel to the Zeolite Cave and pick up one white @item{Zeolite} crystal.

achievements.description: Find a weird door in a cave
achievements.summary: Find the strange Warden door inside the cave at coordinates 922:68:1785.

guide.context: This first Warden discovery does not require a terraformation threshold or a Warden Key.

steps.text: Travel to coordinates 922:68:1785 and enter the nearby cave.
Continue through the cave until the large Warden door is discovered.

achievements.summary: Open a Golden Crate and collect one @item{Golden Seed}.

guide.context: Golden Seeds are restricted to the fixed Golden Crates scattered across Planet Prime.

steps.text: Explore named biomes and wreck surroundings until you locate a gold-colored Golden Crate.
Open the Golden Crate and move the @item{Golden Seed} into your inventory.

achievements.summary: Craft one @item{Fusion Energy Cell} after reaching 360 GTi.

guide.context: The Fusion Energy Cell blueprint unlocks at 360 GTi and later powers wreck doors and Portal Generator construction.

steps.text: Raise the Terraformation Index to 360 GTi so the Fusion Energy Cell recipe unlocks.
Collect 2 Osmium, 3 Pulsar Quartz, and 1 Super Alloy.
Open the crafting station that lists Fusion Energy Cell and craft one cell.

achievements.description: Craft or find a Pulsar Quartz
achievements.summary: Craft or collect one @item{Pulsar Quartz}.

guide.context: Natural Pulsar Quartz can be found in the Meteor Field, Pulsar Quartz Caves, and above the Waterfall; later containers can also hold it.

steps.text: Search the Meteor Field, a Pulsar Quartz Cave, or the ledge above the Waterfall for a pink Pulsar Quartz crystal.
Pick up the @item{Pulsar Quartz}; crafting one from its unlocked recipe also satisfies the achievement.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Outdoor Farm} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 1 Water Bottle, 1 Super Alloy, 1 Fertilizer T2, 1 Fertilizer, and 2 Bee Larvae.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Outdoor Farm}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Ore Extractor}.

guide.context: The blueprint becomes usable when you unlock it by reaching 155 microPascals of Pressure.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Ore Extractor} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 1 Aluminum, 1 Iridium Rod, 2 Osmium, 1 Super Alloy, and 1 Titanium.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Ore Extractor}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Enter the @loc{Mushroom River} through the Waterfall passage at coordinates -207:58:778.

guide.context: The biome also connects to the Meteor Field at -231:45:58 and to the Volcano through a narrow passage beginning at -430:-30:208.

steps.text: Travel to the Waterfall and locate the cave opening at coordinates -207:58:778.
Pass through the opening until the Mushroom River biome name appears.

achievements.summary: Stand in an asteroid impact point and take a direct meteor hit.

guide.context: A Super Alloy meteor shower after 200 MTi produces many fast impacts, making the target easier to line up.

steps.text: Stay outdoors during a meteor shower and watch where the first asteroids strike.
Move onto a repeated impact point and remain there until an asteroid directly damages the player.

achievements.summary: Insert three @item{Warden Keys} into the altar at 1570:106:2478 and enter Ancient Paradise.

guide.context: The altar route becomes usable after 2 GTi; the three inserted keys are separate from the ten keys later stored for the Warden ending.

steps.text: Raise the Terraformation Index to 2 GTi and collect three Warden Keys from the Warden story areas.
Travel to the altar at 1570:106:2478 and insert all three Warden Keys.
Pass through the opened entrance until the Ancient Paradise discovery registers.

achievements.summary: Craft one @item{Drone} after building a Drone Station.

guide.context: The Drone Station unlocks at 53.5 GTi and provides the interface required to create logistics drones.

steps.text: Reach 53.5 GTi, gather the Drone Station recipe materials, and construct a Drone Station.
Collect 1 Circuit Board, 1 Iron, and 1 Rocket Engine.
Open the Drone Station interface and craft one @item{Drone}.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Auto-Crafter}.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Auto-Crafter} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Space Trading Rocket} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 3 Circuit Boards, 1 Rocket Engine, 1 Super Alloy Rod, and 1 Uranium Rod.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Space Trading Rocket}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.description: Gain a total of 100 Terra Tokens
achievements.summary: Gain a cumulative total of 100 @item{Terra Tokens}.

guide.context: The cumulative achievement counter does not require the tokens to remain unspent; trading shipments and collected token chips both add to the total.

steps.text: Reach the Insects stage or build a Space Trading Rocket to begin earning Terra Tokens.
Send requested goods through the Space Trading Rocket and redeem any Terra Token chips until total earnings reach 100.

achievements.summary: Gain a cumulative total of 1,000 @item{Terra Tokens}.

guide.context: The cumulative achievement counter does not require the tokens to remain unspent; trading shipments and collected token chips both add to the total.

steps.text: Reach the Insects stage or build a Space Trading Rocket to begin earning Terra Tokens.

achievements.summary: Gain a cumulative total of 100,000 @item{Terra Tokens}.

achievements.summary: Bake one @item{Cookie} from 3 Chocolate and 3 Flour.

guide.context: The Cookie route requires a Space Trading Rocket, a purchased Cooking Station, Wheat and Cocoa seeds, and crafted Flour and Chocolate.

steps.text: Build a Space Trading Rocket, open its trading console, spend Terra Tokens on the Cooking Station, Wheat Seeds, and Cocoa Seeds, then collect the delivered unlocks and grow both crops.
Use the Cooking Station to craft 3 Flour and 3 Chocolate.
Select the Cookie recipe in the Cooking Station and bake one @item{Cookie}.

achievements.summary: Create one DNA Sequence in a @item{Genetic Synthesizer}.

guide.context: The Genetic Synthesizer unlocks at 52 kt of Biomass and combines one Species trait with two color traits.

steps.text: Reach 52 kt of Biomass, then construct a Genetic Synthesizer using 1 Super Alloy Rod, 1 Quasar Quartz, 1 Mutagen T4, 1 Magnetar Quartz, 1 Circuit Board, and 1 Blazar Quartz.
Load the Genetic Synthesizer with one Color B Genetic Trait, one Color A Genetic Trait, and one Species Genetic Trait.
Start synthesis and collect the completed DNA Sequence.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Portal Generator}.

guide.context: The blueprint becomes usable when you unlock it at 250 GTi.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Portal Generator} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 2 Circuit Boards, 2 Energy Multiplier Fuses, 2 Fusion Energy Cells, 1 Compass Microchip, and 2 Super Alloy Rods.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Portal Generator}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Construct one @item{Animal Shelter}.

guide.context: The blueprint becomes usable when you unlock it at 1.25 TTi.

steps.text: Progress until the @item{Animal Shelter} blueprint appears in the Construction menu.
Collect 1 Water Bottle, 1 Silk, 1 Seed Lirma, 1 Methane Cartridge, 1 Fertilizer T2, and 1 Circuit Board.
Open the Construction menu, select @item{Animal Shelter}, place it in a valid location, and finish construction.

achievements.summary: Craft 10 items at crafting stations or Auto-Crafters.

guide.context: Placed structures do not count toward this cumulative total; station-crafted and Auto-Crafter-produced items do.

steps.text: Use manual crafting stations or Auto-Crafters to produce items until the cumulative crafted-item counter reaches 10.

achievements.summary: Craft 100 items at crafting stations or Auto-Crafters.

guide.context: Placed structures do not count toward this cumulative total; station-crafted and Auto-Crafter-produced items do.

steps.text: Use manual crafting stations or Auto-Crafters to produce items until the cumulative crafted-item counter reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Craft 1,000 items at crafting stations or Auto-Crafters.

guide.context: Placed structures do not count toward this cumulative total; station-crafted and Auto-Crafter-produced items do.

steps.text: Use manual crafting stations or Auto-Crafters to produce items until the cumulative crafted-item counter reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Leave the planet with Sentinel Corp
achievements.summary: Destroy the Warden anomaly, then leave Planet Prime with @npc{Sentinel Corp}.

guide.context: After an ending, reload the automatic pre-departure save to prepare another route; the Sentinel Corp, smugglers, and Wardens departures can therefore be earned on one world.

steps.text: Reach 4 TTi and the Complete Terraformation stage, then read Sentinel Corp's anomaly message to unlock the Large Explosive Device.
Craft the Large Explosive Device, follow the Extraction Platform's anomaly waypoint, place the device beneath the Warden anomaly, and detonate it.
Construct an Extraction Platform and open its departure console.
Select the departure option that explicitly names Sentinel Corp and complete the ending sequence.

achievements.summary: Leave aboard the smuggler ship after reserving 250,000 @item{Terra Tokens} and depositing 5 Solar Quartz.

guide.context: After an ending, reload the automatic pre-departure save to prepare another route; the Sentinel Corp, smugglers, and Wardens departures can therefore be earned on one world.

steps.text: Reach Complete Terraformation, destroy the Warden anomaly with a Large Explosive Device, and read Riley's final smuggler message.
Accumulate and keep 250,000 Terra Tokens unspent, then collect 5 Solar Quartz.
Construct an Extraction Platform and place all 5 Solar Quartz in its storage.
Open the departure console, select the option that explicitly names the smugglers and their 250,000-token payment, and complete the ending.

achievements.description: Leave the planet with the Wardens portal
achievements.summary: Store 10 @item{Warden Keys} in the Extraction Platform and leave through the Wardens portal.

guide.context: After an ending, reload the automatic pre-departure save to prepare another route; the Sentinel Corp, smugglers, and Wardens departures can therefore be earned on one world.

steps.text: Reach 32 GTi, enter The Cenote through Meteor Crater's northwest opening, collect the Warden Key Detector blueprint, craft the detector, and equip it.
Follow the detector to hidden Warden chests around Planet Prime until 10 Warden Keys remain after opening the three-key Ancient Paradise altar.
Reach 4 TTi, construct an Extraction Platform, and place 10 Warden Keys in its storage.
Open the departure console and select the option that explicitly leaves with the Wardens portal.

achievements.summary: Enter @loc{Rainbow Caves} through the Grasslands canyon at coordinates 2091:9:1616 after 425 GTi.

guide.context: Other entrances exist in the Highlands at 1824:4:2024 and through the Uranium Cave at 1955:8:1831.

steps.text: Raise the Terraformation Index to 425 GTi so the cave route is accessible.
Travel to the Grasslands canyon entrance at 2091:9:1616 and continue inside until the Rainbow Caves biome name appears.

achievements.summary: Touch the lava in the Volcano biome and take lava damage.

guide.context: The Volcano lies on the southeast side of Planet Prime and connects to Mushroom River through a narrow passage.

steps.text: Travel to the Volcano biome on the southeast side of the map.
Step into an exposed lava pool until the damage effect is applied, then leave the lava before health is depleted.

achievements.summary: Raise the Terraformation Index to 1.25 TTi and reach the @mechanic{Mammals} stage.

guide.context: The Terraformation Index combines Oxygen, Heat, Pressure, and Biomass; Biomass itself combines Plants, Insects, and Animals.

steps.text: Keep the highest available Oxygen, Heat, Pressure, and Biomass machines powered, and launch multiplier rockets when their blueprints become available.

achievements.summary: Collect one @item{Solar Quartz} from the yellow-crystal room in Rainbow Caves.

guide.context: Natural Solar Quartz becomes available at the Mammals stage; a Portal Generator can provide another route to the resource earlier.

steps.text: Reach the Mammals stage or unlock portal exploration, then enter Rainbow Caves.
Locate the room above the Blazar Quartz area that contains yellow crystals.
Pick up one yellow @item{Solar Quartz}.

achievements.summary: Reach 32 GTi, approach Meteor Crater from its northwest rim, and enter @loc{The Cenote}.

guide.context: The Cenote also contains the Warden Key Detector blueprint needed for the Warden ending route.

steps.text: Raise the Terraformation Index to 32 GTi.
Travel to Meteor Crater, follow its rim counterclockwise to the northwest opening, and descend into The Cenote.
Continue inside until The Cenote biome name appears.
